paragraphs: CivicSmart sells cities a curb management system spanning smart hardware at the space, real-time intelligence on every event, enforcement, and the operations software that ties them together. It also aims at universities and campuses. Airports and transit hubs are another target, where rideshare zones, cell lots and passenger loading need managing.

Product lines run from single-space and multi-space meters with integrated sensor options. Curb sensors report real-time occupancy, plate capture, and evidence-grade detection. LaneMaster devices provide automated lane management for loading, pickup-dropoff, rideshare and commercial corridors. Officers write citations on AutoISSUE handhelds. PEMS unifies every meter, sensor, handheld and citation into one dashboard. It publishes open REST endpoints so cities can bring their own BI, GIS and analytics tools.

CivicSmart, Inc. describes itself as a Wisconsin company founded in 2015 around the idea of reimagining the curb. It says it acquired Duncan Parking Technologies from Duncan Solutions in 2015 and renamed it CivicSmart Parking Technologies. The site claims more than 1,500 cities and agencies served. It also claims more than 15 million parking meters shipped. The company says its team holds patents globally for vehicle-detection sensors and parking technologies.
